text: Harborview Health Partners runs insurance claims for fifteen clinics and forty thousand patients through one flat export and one shared login -- giving billing staff, clinical quality reviewers, and compliance the exact same access to every patient's name and Social Security number.

Discovery found three very different jobs behind that login: Billing and Finance need clinic totals. Clinical Quality needs de-identified trends. Only a four-person compliance audit team actually needs full, identifiable records.
The real risk: full names and SSNs are visible to everyone today, and there's no audit trail proving who looked at what, or why.
That gap gets written down first, before a single catalog or table gets built.
The discovery meeting is done. Next: turning 'lock this down' into a policy specific enough to actually test.
